scope: Preparation and review of the held-out E1/E2/C0 evaluation plan only. No held-out feature materialization for inference, no model prediction, no canonical scientific execution, no PR merge, and no publication/result claims.

research_questions.RQ1: Equal-information policy comparison: deterministic versus learned selectors under identical policy-visible evidence.
research_questions.RQ2: Trust-domain separation: changes in unsafe-recovery and false-conservative outcomes as source/key/execution/transport/authority separation changes.
research_questions.RQ3: Common-cause failure: conditions under which corroboration benefit collapses under shared-domain/common-cause compromise.
research_questions.RQ4: Topology/fault transfer: learned-selector behavior on fault classes and higher-separation topologies excluded from training.

held_out_population.row_order: block order above, then ascending numeric scenario suffix

required_checks_before_any_future_infere: separate held-out evaluation authorization exists and exactly names S7E-AERC-HELDOUT-PLAN-001
decoded L0/L1 joblib SHA-256 values match the model-freeze manifest
Python/dependency inventory matches the model-freeze binding before any joblib load
scenario manifest hash is bound before evaluation
exact expected held-out cardinalities 84/104/8 and total 196 are verified
TR0/TR1 are excluded from evaluation outputs
policy input schemas are exactly the frozen 9-feature and 16-feature orders

primary_policy_engine.D0_BASE: frozen deterministic comparator over exact BASE_FEATURES
primary_policy_engine.L0_BASE: hash-verified frozen L0 joblib under bound runtime environment
primary_policy_engine.D1_CORROBORATED: frozen deterministic comparator over exact EXTENDED_FEATURES
primary_policy_engine.L1_CORROBORATED: hash-verified frozen L1 joblib under bound runtime environment

independent_audit_engine.deterministic_policies: separately implemented rule evaluator from frozen definitions
independent_audit_engine.learned_policies: pure semantic-tree interpreter over frozen canonical semantic JSON; do not deserialize joblib
independent_audit_engine.required_identity: audit action must equal primary action for every learned-policy decision
independent_audit_engine.audit_failure_effect: scenario invalid and campaign not eligible for final aggregate release

execution_design.truth_join: Research-only objective action and topology/fault metadata are joined only after policy input capture and policy decisions; they are never supplied to a policy engine.

scenario_valid_iff: intended fault confirmed by harness instrumentation
research-only adjudication truth absent from policy inputs
primary and independent-audit learned actions agree
action sink records the same scenario ID
validity_rule.if_any_invalid: retain the attempt and explicit invalid reason; do not compute/release final complete-population aggregate results from that execution; no hidden replacement scenario or silent retry
validity_rule.retry_policy: any later campaign attempt requires a new explicit execution identifier and retains prior invalid attempt provenance

decision_record_schema.canonical_format: UTF-8 canonical JSON Lines; lexicographic keys; separators ',' ':'; terminal newline

per_policy_per_block: unsafe_proceed = count(action == ENTER_RECOVERY_GATE and objective_action == HOLD)
false_conservative_hold = count(action == HOLD and objective_action == ENTER_RECOVERY_GATE)
exact action counts for HOLD and ENTER_RECOVERY_GATE
paired_policy_disagreement: D0_BASE versus L0_BASE exact disagreement count
D1_CORROBORATED versus L1_CORROBORATED exact disagreement count
trust_architecture: exact unsafe_proceed count changes across topology strata
exact false_conservative_hold count changes across topology strata
corroboration delta within deterministic class: D1_CORROBORATED minus D0_BASE
corroboration delta within learned class: L1_CORROBORATED minus L0_BASE
common-cause behavior under F10 and F11, stratified by topology and especially shared-authority T0-T3 versus authority-separated T4
primary_endpoints.finite_population_rule: All endpoints are exact finite-population counts. Descriptive proportions may be reported only with exact numerators and denominators.

secondary_endpoints: policy disagreement by topology and fault profile
frozen learner tree structure and depth (reported from freeze manifest, not recomputed by held-out fitting)
training error reported separately from the frozen training record and never pooled with held-out outcomes

findings: The plan preserves all primary and secondary endpoints predeclared by the prospective protocol.
The complete finite population makes exact counts and descriptive proportions appropriate; significance testing is intentionally excluded.
Primary joblib inference and independent semantic-tree audit provide implementation diversity without refitting models.
Zero invalid scenarios are required before complete-population aggregate results can be released.
Topology/fault stratification prevents aggregate counts from being presented as a global policy ranking.
Research-only truth is joined after decision capture and remains prohibited from policy input.

next_gate: Static qualification of this plan, followed by separate explicit authorization before any E1/E2/C0 feature materialization for inference or model prediction.
